import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Create a new column for Age
data['Age'] = 2023 - data['Year_Birth']

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a violin plot to visualize Income distribution by Education level
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.violinplot(x='Education', y='Income', data=data, inner='quartile', palette='muted')

# Add titles and labels
plt.title('Income Distribution by Education Level', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Education Level', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Income', fontsize=14)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
